title: Use Group V
previewText: For the purposes of this Chapter, the definition of transient hotel shall be modified to allow only such hotels used exclusively for transient occupancy. Such transient hotels used exclusively for transient occupancy shall be permitted only in specified locations as set forth in this Chapter, where permitted pursuant to Section 32-153 (Use Group V – uses subject to additional conditions).
